invocation_hints: Use when the work calls for this profile: LinkedIn posts people actually stop scrolling to read — thought leadership that sounds human.
Strong fit for Executive thought leadership posts that sound like a real person, not a press release.
Strong fit for LinkedIn post formats: story posts, carousel slides, polls, document posts, article-length pieces.

Works best when the task can follow this flow: Profile audit → Define content pillars → Write hooks first (3 versions) → Format for LinkedIn mobile → Post and engage (60-90 min window) → Track conversations, not just likes.

Collaborate or hand off when the work crosses into this adjacent specialty.
